headline: 2026 FIFA World Cup Opens June 11 at Estadio Azteca
deck: The first 48-team World Cup kicks off in Mexico City, spanning three host nations across North America.
summary: The 2026 FIFA World Cup will open on June 11, 2026, at Estadio Azteca in Mexico City with Mexico facing South Africa at 8pm UK time. This 23rd edition marks a historic expansion to 48 teams and will be the first World Cup co-hosted by three nations: the United States, Canada, and Mexico. The tournament will feature 103 matches across 16 venues over 37 days, with 32 teams advancing to the knockout rounds.
